City of Inglewood

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  September 14, 2020

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was held in the 1st Floor, Finance Conference Room at
11:40 a.m.:

  Members Present:  Maria Heaney, Finance Department
  Derald Brenneman, City Attorney’s Office
  Aisha Thompson, City Clerk’s Office (Call-In)

  Staff Present:  Juan Trinidad, Energy Operations Supervisor
  Lori Jones, Grants Coordinator
  Micah Herd, Police Grant Coordinator

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

1. The minutes of August 24, 2020, meeting was approved as recorded.

2. Sunbelt Rentals – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for rental of generators for
  the Police Department in the amount of $3,331.99. Motion carried unanimously.

3. Amber Motel – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing emergency
  homeless shelter in the amount of $375.00. Motion carried unanimously.

4. Industrial Electric Commercial Parts & Services, LLC – Executive session to discuss recommend
  payment for emergency repairs to the Senior Center walk in freezer in the amount of $7,499.30.
  Motion carried unanimously.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Maria Heaney reported no public comments. There being no further business, the meeting adjourned
at 11:37 a.m. Adjournment
